title: List of traders
html:
This article is about the user curated list of traders organized by location with information about wares. For the automatically generated list of characters tagged as traders, see Category:Traders.

This article lists all traders in Baldur's Gate 3. Some traders (also known as merchants) may become inaccessible depending on certain story choices.

Act One

Wilderness

 Auntie Ethel Emerald Grove[1] Normal Potions and lotions and alchemy

  2. ↑ Non-unique magic weapons, goblin gear, misc supplies.
  3. ↑ Relocates to the Goblin Camp, and then the party's Camp after being rescued.

Act Two

Most traders from Act One can still be accessed during Act Two. If relocating, they retain their attitude from previous sessions.

  1. ↑ 1.0 1.1 Balthazar and He Who Was are not traders in the sense that they are not marked with on the map and there is no dialogue to open trading interface when talking to them, but they (especially Balthazar) have more useful items for sale than other NPCs.
  2. ↑ Has a "gold stash" like typical fightable enemies rather than trader gold.
  3. ↑ Relocates to Moonrise Towers at the end of the Act.
